# Joseph and His Coat (Genesis 39:2)

## Emotional Focus
Thankfulness even when life feels colorful and surprising.

## Key KJV
“But the LORD was with Joseph.” (Genesis 39:2)

## Gentle Retelling
Joseph had a beautiful coat of many colors. Even when hard things happened, God stayed with him and turned everything into something good.

## Coloring Prompt
Young Joseph in his bright coat of many colors looking hopeful.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
